summary: V1.3 testing — canonical_club normalisation, isNewClub flag, POST/GET /club-claim, leaderboard canonical filter, frontend Pricing (5 tiers), DecisionGame (6 animated scenarios), ClubClaimModal all PASS. Rate limiting is BROKEN in the preview environment: slowapi's default get_remote_address uses request.client.host which returns the Kubernetes ingress pod IP — and requests alternate between TWO ingress pods (10.79.131.92 & .93), so each caller is effectively two independent keys. 22 rapid /score requests and 7 rapid /club-claim requests all returned 201 with no 429. This means rate limiting provides no real protection against leaderboard spam in production.

critical.issue: Rate limiting does NOT fire — slowapi key_func=get_remote_address resolves to rotating k8s ingress pod IPs (10.79.131.92 / .93). Tested 22 rapid POSTs to /score and 7 to /club-claim, all returned 201. FIX: implement a custom key_func that reads X-Forwarded-For header, e.g. `lambda req: (req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') or req.client.host).split(',')[0].strip()` — and add SlowAPIMiddleware for consistent request-state propagation.

minor.issue: canonical_club() title-cases arbitrary all-caps tokens (e.g. 'TEST' → 'Test', 'UI' → 'Ui'). Users submitting legitimate all-caps acronyms (AFC, SSFC, PSG) only survive if the token is in _KEEP_UPPER. Acceptable for MVP but worth expanding _KEEP_UPPER or preserving any token that's already fully uppercase & >=2 chars.
slowapi uses in-memory MemoryStorage by default — counters reset on backend reload. Use Redis-backed storage for production.

action_items: Fix slowapi key_func to honour X-Forwarded-For header so rate limits apply per real client IP, not per ingress pod. Also add SlowAPIMiddleware(app).
(Optional) Expand _KEEP_UPPER or preserve tokens that are already fully uppercase with length >= 2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: slowapi limiter is declared but will NOT block spam in k8s because the decorator uses request.client.host — this hits the ingress IP which alternates. Root cause of rate-limit-not-triggering bug. Trust X-Forwarded-For.

server.py: SlowAPIMiddleware is not added — decorator-only usage works for basic cases but middleware ensures request.state.view_rate_limit is populated before the view runs and keeps error-handler context consistent.
server.py: @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still deprecated — migrate to lifespan context manager.
server.py: club_claims are logged including email + name at INFO level — fine for internal, but consider redacting if logs go to third-party aggregator.

ClubClaimModal.jsx: uses uncontrolled click-outside-to-close (backdrop onClick={onClose}) even mid-submit. A slip while typing could dismiss half-completed lead data. Consider guarding with `if (submitting) return;`.

Demo.jsx: claim modal trigger relies only on frontend state `isNewClub` from the first score POST. If a user plays multiple rounds for the SAME new club, isNewClub stays true and the modal opens at the end — fine UX, but note it is driven solely by the first submission's flag and won't re-evaluate server-side at leaderboard time.

DecisionGame.jsx: phase gating disables A/B/C buttons outside `deciding`, but the on-click still fires handlePick which early-returns — safe. Animation duration hard-coded to max(anim durations) + 350ms; if Phaser fails to load on slow connections the question overlay never shows. Consider a fallback timeout to force 'deciding' after 4s.

rca of the issue: Rate limiting: slowapi Limiter(key_func=get_remote_address). get_remote_address() returns request.client.host which in a Kubernetes setup is the ingress sidecar's IP, not the real client. Backend stdout shows requests alternating between 10.79.131.92 and 10.79.131.93 (two ingress pods), so for any single client the rate-limit counter is split across two keys — effectively doubling the real budget AND letting large bursts through undetected. Reproduction: `for i in {1..25}; do curl -X POST $URL/api/score -d '{...}'; done` → observe all 201s. Mitigation: custom key_func reading X-Forwarded-For (first entry), plus `app.add_middleware(SlowAPIMiddleware)` for consistent state.
